edges.reason: msg.sender is passed directly as the mint recipient in _mint(msg.sender, totalSupply())
PRICE is multiplied by count to compute the required payment
MAX_SUPPLY is compared against totalSupply() + count - 1
MAX_MULTIMINT bounds the count argument in mint
supplyCounter is read through totalSupply() and incremented during mint
require(saleIsActive) gates execution of mint
count parameter drives the payment, supply and batch-size arithmetic in mint
Loop index i controls the minting iteration
msg.sender is passed as the recipient in the freeMint _mint call
MAX_FREE_SUPPLY is compared against totalSupply() + count - 1
MAX_FREE_MULTIMINT bounds the count argument in freeMint
supplyCounter is read and incremented during freeMint
require(saleIsActive) gates execution of freeMint
count parameter drives the free supply arithmetic in freeMint
Loop index i controls the freeMint iteration
totalSupply returns supplyCounter.current()
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the resolved owner
saleIsActive_ parameter is written into the saleIsActive state variable
setSaleIsActive writes the saleIsActive state variable controlling minting
onlyOwner restricts setBaseURI to the contract owner
customBaseURI_ parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI on the implementation
onlyOwner restricts setExtensionURI to the contract owner
customExtensionURI_ parameter is stored into extensionURI
setExtensionURI writes the extensionURI state variable
tokenId parameter is used to query the implementation token URI
extensionURI is appended to the base token URI in tokenURI
onlyOwner on withdraw verifies msg.sender is the owner
Local balance captures address(this).balance before the transfer
withdraw performs an external value transfer via Address.sendValue, handing control to the recipient
The delegated constructor performs a delegatecall into the supplied base implementation
mint increments supplyCounter for every minted token
freeMint increments supplyCounter for every minted token

normalization_plan.reason: The count parameter of mint is only used inside mint to bound batches and compute payment, so it is subsumed by the mint function node
The count parameter of freeMint is only used inside freeMint for supply and batch checks, so it is subsumed by the freeMint function node
saleIsActive_ exists only to be written to the saleIsActive flag by setSaleIsActive
customBaseURI_ is only forwarded by setBaseURI into the implementation base URI setter
customExtensionURI_ is only assigned to extensionURI inside setExtensionURI
tokenId is only consumed by tokenURI to build the returned URI string
The loop counter i has no meaning outside the mint loop and is absorbed into the mint function node
The loop counter i has no meaning outside the freeMint loop and is absorbed into the freeMint function node
balance is a transient local holding address(this).balance and is fully captured by the withdraw function node
